heading_en: Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio for Adopting and Continuing to Use the Internal Ratings-Based Approach
summary_ja: 内部格付手法の採用及び継続使用の条件として連結自己資本規制比率が八パーセント以上であることを定める。
summary_en: Makes a ratio of at least 8% under Article 2, item (iii) a condition for adopting and continuing to use the internal ratings-based approach.
paragraphs: For an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that uses the internal ratings-based approach, the ratio obtained by the formula in Article 2, item (iii) being 8% or more is a condition for the adoption and continued use of that approach.
